description: FIELD TWIN is climate-adaptive agricultural digital twin turning NASA data into practical solutions. It links climate change, heatwaves, soil, water, ecosystems, human behavior, labor, technology, and economics. It simulates future scenarios, predicts risks, and tests crop choices, rotation, planting dates, and irrigation. By comparing impacts on yield, soil health, water, worker safety, emissions, and costs, it helps farmers choose resilient actions and protect agriculture as conditions change.

3. It uses NASA data (SMAP, Landsat/HLS, MODIS, GPM, POWER) to track NDVI, NDMI, soil moisture, temperature, and rainfall.
4. Every indicator shows its source, date, resolution, and quality, and estimates are never presented as lab measurements.
5. Soil analysis, weather intelligence, and an early warning system turn the data into clear alerts and recommendations.
6. The AI Plant Doctor reads leaf photos and states its confidence, and it never gives an uncertain diagnosis as confirmed.
7. The AI assistant speaks English, Modern Standard Arabic, and Egyptian colloquial Arabic, with text and voice.

details:
AgriMate AI: Project Details

Concept

A smart agricultural web platform that helps farmers manage their land from preparation and planting through to harvest, using NASA satellite data, soil analysis, weather intelligence, and AI.

The Problem

Farmers often make decisions about irrigation, fertilizing, and treatment based on experience or guesswork.

Satellite data exists but is hard for non-specialists to use.

No simple tool speaks to farmers in their own dialect and explains the numbers.

Users

Farmers with limited technical experience, agricultural engineers, and farm managers.

Core Features

Farm management: Register fields, draw boundaries on a map, calculate area, assign crops to each field, with GeoJSON support.

Satellite insights:

SMAP for soil moisture.

Landsat and HLS for vegetation indices (NDVI, NDMI).

MODIS for land surface temperature.

GPM for precipitation.

POWER for climate data.

Soil analysis: pH, NPK, texture, and fertility, clearly separating laboratory measurements, user-entered values, and remote estimates.

Weather: Current conditions, forecasts, and agricultural warnings tied to the farmer’s crops.

AI Plant Doctor: Analyzes leaf photos, states its confidence, suggests extra checks, and recommends a specialist when uncertain.

Irrigation and fertilization: Recommendations that explain their reasoning, with no exact quantities unless there is enough field-specific data.

Crop calendar: Tasks for land preparation, planting, irrigation, fertilizing, inspection, and harvest, with completion tracking.

Early warning system: Each alert shows severity, affected field, date, supporting data, and a recommended action.

AI assistant: Supports English, Modern Standard Arabic, and Egyptian colloquial Arabic, in text and voice. It asks follow-up questions and uses field data.

Guiding Principles

Transparency: Every indicator shows its source, date, resolution, and quality.

Scientific honesty: Estimates are never presented as lab measurements, and there is no fake live data. If an API isn’t connected, data is labeled as sample data.

Simplicity: Plain terminology, clear icons, and voice interaction.

Security: API keys stay server-side only.

Visual Identity

Only three primary colors: Forest Green

#245C43, Soft Sage

#E8F0E8, and Warm Off-White

#F4F3EA. The design is calm and minimal, with rounded cards and clear typography, and no heavy gradients or cartoonish illustrations.

Language

The interface defaults to English, with an Arabic switcher and full RTL layout. The assistant understands Egyptian colloquial Arabic even when the dashboard is in English.

Proposed Architecture

Layer Technologies

Frontend Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Backend Python, FastAPI

Database PostgreSQL with PostGIS

Geospatial Google Earth Engine, GeoJSON, Leaflet or Mapbox

AI LLM with RAG, a vision model for plant images, speech-to-text and text-to-speech

Data NASA POWER and NASA Earthdata

Current Status

A single-page HTML prototype with a dashboard, satellite, soil, weather, irrigation, and calendar views, a plant doctor and assistant with canned responses, Arabic/English, and dark mode. All data is labeled sample data.

Suggested Roadmap

Phase 1: Rebuild in Next.js with a real map and field boundary drawing.

Phase 2: Connect NASA POWER first (the easiest), then SMAP and HLS through Earth Engine.

Phase 3: Real assistant with an LLM and RAG over trusted agricultural references, then voice.

Phase 4: Plant Doctor with a vision model, plus automatic alerts.

Phase 5: Pilot with real farmers and refine dialect support and usability.
